units.source_text: 发长彦大惊失色，急忙扑向两位武士。

en.t: Hatsunagahiko turned pale with shock and hurriedly lunged toward the two warriors.

units.source_text: 但是为时晚矣，那时候已经吹起旋风，黑狗已经卷起尾巴，飞向湛蓝的天空了。

en.t: But it was too late; by then a whirlwind had already risen, and the black dog had already curled its tail and flown into the deep blue sky.
